name: Replika
ontology_notes: Help Center: Memory tab of saved facts (user, pets, people) plus a deeper undocumented layer from conversation patterns. Profile fields (name, gender). Diary mentioned as remaining when chat history ages out. Backstory article exists in the Conversation category. Internals INCONCLUSIVE.

ontology.evidence: Visible Memory tab facts plus opaque 'layers'. Profile vs memories vs diary. No public relationship_state type. Internals INCONCLUSIVE.
ontology.label: measured

write_policy.evidence: Auto-generated memories plus manual add in Memory tab. Upvote/affirm to reinforce. Help prefers leaving auto memory on. Internals INCONCLUSIVE.
write_policy.label: measured

read_policy.evidence: Facts about me command surfaces one remembered fact. How facts are injected per turn is unpublished. Internals INCONCLUSIVE.
read_policy.label: guess

supersession.evidence: User can delete a memory. How contradictions are resolved automatically is unpublished. Internals INCONCLUSIVE.
supersession.label: guess

temporal.evidence: Chat history UI is last four months only (help article). Memory/personality claimed retained beyond that. No 'last Tuesday' query documented. Internals INCONCLUSIVE.
temporal.label: measured

identity_split.evidence: User profile vs Replika name/gender vs Memory tab vs diary. Relationship is not a separate public type. Internals INCONCLUSIVE.
identity_split.label: inferred

silence.evidence: Delete memory is the published control. No silence taxonomy. Internals INCONCLUSIVE.
silence.label: guess

forgetting.evidence: Tap a memory to remove it. Deleting 'may affect' recall. Chat history beyond four months is not retrievable in UI but claimed not to wipe training. Internals INCONCLUSIVE.
forgetting.label: measured

cost_shape.evidence: Hosted. No public token budget. Internals INCONCLUSIVE.
cost_shape.label: guess

local.evidence: Closed cloud app. The phrase 'works locally within your experience' in the memory article is not a self-host license. Internals INCONCLUSIVE.
local.label: measured

mcp.evidence: No official MCP server in help reviewed.
mcp.label: measured

companion_fit_reason: A dedicated companion with a user-visible fact list and claimed long-lived training. Public docs do not show typed relationship state or a silence policy. Chat UI itself is not infinite. Internals INCONCLUSIVE.
